sources.docsNotUsed: 3dStructure.md 9h and docs/trading-floor-arena.md were not needed; every value below comes from code.

tradingFloorRoom.phase: both (TRADING_FLOOR_POLICY and slot capabilities unchanged in part 2 and P15)
tradingFloorRoom.sprintKey: ShiftLeft or ShiftRight held with WASD (RUN_SPEED_MULT 2.025)
tradingFloorRoom.moveKeys: KeyW/KeyA/KeyS/KeyD, CAMERA-RELATIVE. At camera yaw 0 (arrival): W = -Z (toward board), S = +Z (toward door), A = -X, D = +X. After a 180 deg turn (yaw +-pi): W = +Z, D = -X.
tradingFloorRoom.keyIdentity: event.code (KeyW etc.); CDP Input.dispatchKeyEvent must send 'code'.
tradingFloorRoom.keyTargetGuard: keys typed in an editable element (the name input) never move the avatar
tradingFloorRoom.maxDeltaSeconds: 0.1: below 10 FPS the avatar covers LESS than hold x speed. Prefer DOM waitFor over pure timing.
tradingFloorRoom.cameraYaw: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight at 1.25 rad/s. 90 deg = 1257 ms, 180 deg = 2513 ms. ArrowLeft decreases yaw.
tradingFloorRoom.cameraPitch: ArrowUp / ArrowDown change camera HEIGHT offset at 180 wu/s, clamp -120..+150 (0 at arrival). It is a height offset, not an angle.
tradingFloorRoom.leftDragOrbit: Left mouse drag on the canvas (slop 4 px). yaw rad = 2*pi*dx/canvasClientHeight (desktop speed 1). 180 deg = clientHeight/2 px; on a 1080-high canvas 540 px. Vertical drag raises/lowers the camera. Blocked while the Exchange modal is open.
tradingFloorRoom.chaseCamera: fov 60, behind 520, above 260, lookY 180, lookAhead 140. Spring arm shortens against walls, desks, pillars, kiosk; claws only when camera y < 242. Arm grows back with rate 4/s. Camera yaw only changes from arrows/drag (no auto-follow); on sit it eases to face the desk.
tradingFloorRoom.E: One ladder: stand > monitor > door > sit > (P15 only) house-agent walk-up. Ignored while the Exchange modal is open.
tradingFloorRoom.Escape: Modal open: closes the modal and does NOT stand. Modal closed and seated: stands up. So two Escapes = close panel + stand.
tradingFloorRoom.seatedMove: Any WASD while seated stands the player up on that frame.

gameWorld.moveKeys: WASD camera-relative (same intent code as the room).
gameWorld.cameraOrbitKeys: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight orbit at 1.5 rad/s (180 deg = 2094 ms); ArrowUp/ArrowDown tilt.
gameWorld.mouseOrbit: drei OrbitControls, rotateSpeed 1: 180 deg = canvasClientHeight/2 px left-drag. Wheel zooms.
gameWorld.followCamera: FPSFollowCamera keeps the orbit angle and a 240 wu radius. Fresh load: slot camera at [0,600,1300] relative to origin, so the camera sits SOUTH of the avatar looking NORTH. The Trading Floor is SOUTH, behind the camera.
gameWorld.E: Opens Nori chat if near Nori; else enters nearLocation (Trading Floor door band -> walk-in). Disabled in Autonomous mode.

steps.detail: Open the URL with a logged-in, non-guest account that has an avatar (it is promoted to Controlled mode).
See overlays[]. Set localStorage before load; close the tutorial with Escape if it shows (it eats ArrowRight/Enter).
The toggle (aria-label 'Control mode toggle') must show 'Controlled' active. Click 'Controlled' if 'Autonomous' is active; E is disabled in Autonomous.
Hold ArrowLeft 2094 ms (1.5 rad/s), or left-drag canvasClientHeight/2 px horizontally. Building then sits ahead.

steps.detail: Hold KeyW (forward now = +Z). 2710 wu from z 540 = 4927 ms walk; worst case from z 380 to the wall = 5422 ms. Shift+W sprint: about 2680 ms. Overshoot is safe: the building collider stops the body at z 3362 inside the band. Optional: hold KeyA 364 ms first to pass 200 wu beside Pearl instead of through her (after the turn A = +X).
Press E (code KeyE) or click button[aria-label='Enter the Trading Floor']. Do NOT click the building mesh (no stable coordinates).

Avatar walks to (0,3360) until within 200 game-px or 1500 ms, then the curtain: fadingOut 250 ms -> awaiting (shows 'RIDING THE CURRENT…', lasts until the interior is ready; ready gate has a 1500 ms avatar fallback) -> fadingIn 250 ms -> idle. Cut from the first non-idle frame to the frame it returns to idle.
